correctness.rationale: A deletion bijection proves every mixed factorial moment exactly. Algebra gives strictly negative covariance for n>=3 with a manifestly positive cubic after a shift. The high-moment logarithmic expansion has uniform o(1) error for r+s=O(sqrt n), matching every coefficient and hypothesis of Berzunza Ojeda–Holmgren–Janson, Theorem A.1. The limiting covariance determinant is 387/262144>0. Standard-library exhaustive enumeration of all paired Catalan matchings through seven pairs verifies 68 exact-rational assertions, supplementary to the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The two smallest consecutive-support meandric loop types are canonically motivated, and their exact finite joint law quantifies component competition. The explicitly negative, nonvanishing limiting correlation resolves a concrete two-shape instance of the several-shape Gaussian extension identified in the closest single-shape CLT paper, while the proof identifies precisely the Catalan exclusion mechanism.
